description: DCF Valuation Calculator — Discounted cash flow valuation, offline. fcf= base-year free cash flow (required). Optional: growth= yearly % (one value, or a list like 20;15;10;8;6), years= 1-15 (default 5), discount= WACC % (default 10), terminal_growth= % (default 2.5, Gordon growth) or exit_multiple= (EV/FCF), net_debt=, shares=, price= (adds upside % and UNDERVALUED/FAIRLY_VALUED/OVERVALUED), mid_year=true. Returns projections, PV of FCF, terminal value and its share of EV, enterprise and equity value, per-share value, implied exit multiple or perpetual growth, a 5x5 sensitivity grid and sanity flags. Pair with /v1/finance/wacc. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
